env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^fresh ok$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/fresh

go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"
)

type First struct {
  Name string `json:"name"`
  V int64 `json:"v"`
  Buf []string `json:"buf"`
}

type Second struct {
  Name string `json:"name"`
  V string `json:"v"`
  Buf []string `json:"buf"`
}

type U interface {
  First | Second
}

type H struct {
  Item U `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
  var h H
  err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"name":"x","buf":["a"],"v":"hi"}}`), &h)
  if err != nil {
    panic("fresh unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  s, ok := h.Item.(Second)
  if !ok {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("fresh want Second got %T", h.Item))
  }
  if s.Name != "x" {
    panic("fresh name")
  }
  if s.V != "hi" {
    panic("fresh v")
  }
  if len(s.Buf) != 1 {
    panic("fresh buf len")
  }
  for _, b := range s.Buf {
    if b != "a" {
      panic("fresh buf val")
    }
  }
  fmt.Println("fresh ok")
}
